title: 第13章 无极剑舞第14章 林府副管家
content_zh:
第13章无极剑舞
楚风眠在离开万器阁后，便是直接回到了林府的庭院之中，进入房间，楚风眠便是一下子瘫倒在了床上。
“催动剑意，看来这具身体还没有彻底熟悉啊。”
楚风眠感觉到，他的脑袋便是要炸开了一样。
这便是强行催动剑意的下场。
这道身躯，还没有熟悉剑意，刚刚楚风眠强行催动剑意，虽然成功，但是这也让现在楚风眠的脑袋，剧痛无比。
不过当看到手中那把青色轻剑的时候，楚风眠感觉到就连疼痛，都减轻了不少。
过了一会，楚风眠的疼痛减弱了许久，楚风眠这才座了起来，看着那把玄青剑，嘴角露出几分笑意道。
“这倒是捡了一个大便宜。”
本来楚风眠前往万器阁，也只是想要随意购买一把轻剑的。
只是当看到了那轩景泰伤势的时候，楚风眠才突然想到，伪装了一番，倒是将这把玄青剑白白的拿到了手。
“可算是天剑宗的功法，我还是记得一二的。”
楚风眠心中笑着说道。
剑道之主的收藏之中，也有着天剑宗的功法，楚风眠无聊之时也曾经看见过，刚刚在动用剑意的时刻，他故意释放出了几分天剑宗的功法。
果然是一下子将那轩景泰给震慑住了。
树大招风的道理，楚风眠还是明白的，正因如此，楚风眠才故意伪装成好像他的身后还有着其他一尊大能的存在。
果然是将那轩景泰给震慑住。
“三个条件，这轩景泰倒是好算计。”
楚风眠心中冷笑道。
刚刚轩景泰的举动，楚风眠也清楚，这轩景泰答应给楚风眠三个条件，实际上却是他打算想要依靠楚风眠，来接近楚风眠背后的大能。

不过既然这轩景泰主动送上门来了，楚风眠倒是也来者不拒，一尊神海境，甚至是御风境的强者，这个人情楚风眠还是要的。
有着轩景泰的三个人情，在这林武城中，其他人想要在对付楚风眠，可就不容易了。
论起实力来说，轩景泰在林武城中都足以排的上是前三，更何况他的背后还是庞然大物天剑宗。
绝非是这偏远的林武城敢去得罪的。
“这把玄青剑，倒是对我正好。”
楚风眠看着玄青剑，自言自语道。
选择轻剑，楚风眠也是考虑再三之后才决定的。
若是选择重剑的话，以现在楚风眠的力量，却是并不足以，楚风眠的力量还不足以真正以重剑来动用剑术。
毕竟这具身躯，还太过瘦弱。
而轻剑，虽然威力不足，但是却正好可以让楚风眠施展出他所最为自信的剑术。
一道剑术，真正修炼到大成，越级战斗，也绝非难事。
楚风眠前世剑意无双，在剑术方面，也早已位列巅峰，他的脑海之中几乎记有着天下至高剑术。
楚风眠回想了一下脑海之中记忆，以他现在的境界，大多数剑术，根本是施展不出来。
突然之间，一道影子，却是从楚风眠的脑海之中一闪而过。
“无极剑舞。”
这无极剑舞，也是一道天级中品的剑术，放眼整个武胜国度，绝对是无双一般的剑术。
只是这无极剑舞，却并非是真正的剑术，而是一种舞剑术，他的创造者却是一位同样跟楚风眠一样，无法修炼的武者。
只是此人，虽然无法修炼，但是对剑术领悟却是极高，最终创造出了这无极剑舞。
一开始对着无极剑舞，众人都是无人在意，毕竟一名就连武者都不是的人，创造出来的剑术，又能到什么地步。
后来一直到天剑宗两位长老的一战，其中一名女性长老，用出这无极剑舞，将另外一位长老轻易击败，这无极剑舞的名声才响了起来。

论起实力，还是剑意，那另一位长老都是要远远胜过那位菩翰长老，可是正是依赖这无极剑舞的神奇，菩翰长老才轻易击败了另外一位长老。
这无极剑舞，足以称得上是以弱胜强的第一剑术。
这无极剑舞，对力量的要求并不高，但是对剑意，剑术，却是要求极高，正好是完美符合楚风眠的要求。

Chapter 13 Wuji Sword Dance
After Chu Fengmian left Wanqi Pavilion, he returned directly to the courtyard of Lin Mansion. When he entered the room, Chu Fengmian collapsed on the bed.
"Use the sword intention, it seems that this body is not completely familiar yet."
Chu Fengmian felt that his head was about to explode.
This is the result of forcing the sword to be activated.
This body has not yet become familiar with the sword intention. Just now, Chu Fengmian forced the sword intention. Although it was successful, it also made Chu Fengmian's head feel severe pain.
But when he saw the cyan light sword in his hand, Chu Fengmian felt that even the pain had eased a lot.
After a while, Chu Fengmian's pain subsided for a long time. Chu Fengmian then sat up and looked at the Xuanqing sword with a smile on his lips.
"This is a big bargain."
Originally, Chu Fengmian went to Wanqi Pavilion just to buy a light sword.
It was only when he saw Xuan Jingtai's injury that Chu Fengmian suddenly thought of it, disguised himself, and got the Xuan Qing Sword in vain.
"It can be regarded as the Tianjian Sect's technique, but I still remember one or two of it."
Chu Fengmian said with a smile in his heart.
The master of swordsmanship also has the skills of the Tianjian Sect in his collection. Chu Fengmian had seen it when he was bored. Just when he was using his sword intention, he deliberately released some of the skills of the Tianjian Sect.
Sure enough, Xuan Jingtai was shocked all of a sudden.
Chu Fengmian still understood the principle that a big tree attracts the wind. Because of this, Chu Fengmian deliberately pretended that there was another powerful being behind him.
As expected, Xuan Jingtai was shocked.
"Three conditions, this Xuan Jingtai is really good at calculating."
Chu Fengmian sneered in his heart.
Chu Fengmian also knew what Xuan Jingtai did just now. Xuan Jingtai promised to give Chu Fengmian three conditions, but in fact, he planned to rely on Chu Fengmian to get close to the great power behind Chu Fengmian.
However, since Xuan Jingtai came to his door on his own initiative, Chu Fengmian did not reject anyone who came. A strong man in the Divine Sea Realm, or even the Wind Control Realm, Chu Fengmian still wanted this favor.
With Xuan Jingtai's three favors, it would not be easy for others in Linwu City to deal with Chu Fengmian.
In terms of strength, Xuan Jingtai ranks among the top three in Linwu City, not to mention that behind him is the behemoth Tianjian Sect.
It is definitely not something that this remote Linwucheng dares to offend.
"This Xuanqing sword is just right for me."
Chu Fengmian looked at Xuan Qingjian and said to himself.
Chu Fengmian decided to choose the light sword after careful consideration.
If he chooses the heavy sword, Chu Fengmian's current strength is not enough. Chu Fengmian's strength is not enough to truly use the heavy sword to use swordsmanship.
After all, this body is still too thin.
As for the light sword, although it was not powerful enough, it was just enough for Chu Fengmian to display his most confident swordsmanship.
Once a swordsman is truly practiced to a great level, it is not difficult to fight beyond the level.
In his previous life, Chu Fengmian had unparalleled swordsmanship and was already at the pinnacle of swordsmanship. He almost remembered the world's best swordsmanship in his mind.
Chu Fengmian recalled the memories in his mind. With his current state, most sword skills were simply impossible to perform.
Suddenly, a shadow flashed across Chu Fengmian's mind.
"The Wuji Sword Dance."
This Wuji Sword Dance is also a heaven-level mid-level swordsmanship. Looking at the entire Wusheng Kingdom, it is definitely an unparalleled swordsmanship.
However, this Wuji Sword Dance is not a real sword skill, but a kind of sword dance. Its creator is a warrior who is also unable to practice like Chu Fengmian.
It's just that although this person couldn't practice, his understanding of swordsmanship was extremely high, and he finally created this infinite sword dance.
At the beginning, no one paid much attention to Wuji Sword Dance. After all,How far can the swordsmanship created by a person who is not even a warrior be?
Later, it was not until the battle between two elders of the Tianjian Sect that one of the female elders used the Wuji Sword Dance to easily defeat the other elder, and the reputation of the Wuji Sword Dance became famous.
In terms of strength and sword power, the other elder was far superior to the elder Bohan. However, it was precisely because of the magic of the infinite sword dance that the elder Bohan easily defeated the other elder.
This infinite sword dance can be regarded as the first swordsmanship in which the weak can defeat the strong.
This Wuji Sword Dance does not require high levels of strength, but it does require extremely high levels of sword intent and swordsmanship, which perfectly meets Chu Fengmian's requirements.
